frictions.description: GET /reservations/experiences is named as a public route in VAL-CROSS-010 step 3 (and VAL-ONLINE-024's list) but no such route is mounted in apps/tenant-api; it answers Hono's default 404 {"error":"Endpoint Not Found"} even with everything on (the only /experiences route is the operator one in reservations-operator.ts).
frictions.resolution: Swept every public route that exists (20 routes, all 503 under the switch) and recorded the missing route explicitly. This matters for VAL-ONLINE-024's uniform-404 sweep, not for the kill-switch behavior.

frictions.description: POST /reservations with a trailing slash answers Hono's default 404 instead of the uniform shape; the route is POST /reservations (no slash). Already in the round's runtime findings.
A hold for a localMin that is not a bookable slot answers 409 slot_unavailable, not 429 - the first message-phase hold attempt used 16:45 (between lunch and dinner) and looked like a limit failure.
frictions.resolution: Re-read availability for 2026-11-14 and used real slots (19:30, 19:45, 20:15, 20:45, 21:30).

frictions.description: The confirmation message is delivered after commit during the booking request itself, so the email-off drop happened before the tick; the tick then reported dropped: 0. The Node in-process interval tick runs every 120 s from node boot and does not appear in the HTTP request log, so the exact interval-tick firings were inferred from boot time (17:12:07 and 17:14:07 after the 17:10:07 boot) and confirmed by the absence of any delivery.
frictions.resolution: Recorded both booking-time and tick-time row states; described what actually fired.

frictions.description: US node warm restart takes about 6-15 s; no startup failures occurred across 12 stop/start cycles (6 US + 2 KSA, plus the durability restart).
frictions.resolution: Polled /health with a 40x2 s budget before each probe.
